Pull the brass T-collar DOWN. The box is a hot plasma — free electrons everywhere, light trapped in a glowing fog. As you cool past the bright τ* line, electrons fall into atoms (recombination), the fog thins and SNAPS transparent, and the trapped light — the cosmic background — streams out at you. The knob is temperature, never time.

Every number comes from the SAME meanFreePath(τ) the fog, the glyph and the SNAP read. λ blows up exactly as the fog lets go.

The tracked photon

One bright disc inside the box. Above τ* it scatters off a free electron almost every step — a dense zigzag scribble going nowhere. Cool past τ* and it locks a heading and flies dead-straight out, reddening to CMB cream.

trapped — ricochets: 0 (λ ≈ 1.0 box-widths)

Hold the box HOT — the neg-control

Pin the box hot and wait as long as you like: xₑ stays high, λ stays bounded, the fog never thins, the photon keeps ricocheting. Transparency is born of RECOMBINATION — crossing the temperature line — NOT of mere elapsed time.

note the model has NO time term — only τ. A held-hot box provably cannot clear by waiting.

The same sky

Across the Rise, First Light dilates the patch with no middle. Here the patch clears: the same cooling universe, one step later — the moment the fog let the light go, and the first light we still see today set out.
